enemy_class_notes: Static map markers describe encounter loci, not a guaranteed spawned enemy tier.
Elite is a runtime stronger variant with additional affixes; no static E marker is emitted.
Operatives are co-op-only runtime enemies and therefore have no static map marker.
Mutation Agent is labeled A only for an exact authored actor; campaign horde anchors do not imply one.
Captain boss pits occur outside X-4; X-4 boss pits contain Destructors.

enemies.name: Fragbot Mech
descriptions: Highly resistant to energy damage; attacks with rapid-fire machine guns.
enemies.behavior: It publishes rank-shaped 250/500/750 Energy Defense and fires its recovered five-shot burst.

enemies.name: Dynosphere
descriptions: Straightforward melee protected by a periodically recharging absorption shield.
enemies.behavior: Its frontal melee is unchanged and its visible rank-shaped absorption shield recharges after 12/10/8 seconds.

enemies.name: Laser Tank
descriptions: Highly resists Energy damage and fires up to three sustained laser beams.
enemies.behavior: It now publishes rank-shaped Energy Defense and its recovered cone zone sustains up to three one-second target pulses.

enemies.name: Reconstructionist
descriptions: Ground slam knocks nearby heroes upward; when damaged, repairs itself.
enemies.behavior: Its phase chooses ranked self-repair while wounded, otherwise radial Ground Slam or close Piston Punch.

enemies.name: Homing Striker
descriptions: Fires projectiles that periodically home in on the closest hero.
The projectiles will expire after a short period of time.
enemies.behavior: Its retained-target projectile begins homing after one second and is bounded by the authored 18-unit lifetime.

enemies.name: Cannonator
descriptions: Fires a large slow moving projectile when at a distance from his target.
When engaging in close combat, will switch to close range melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: Authored phase order selects the slow projectile beyond eight units and melee at eight or nearer.

enemies.name: Magnetic Master
descriptions: Support enemy who tries to stay away from close combat.
Mastery of gravity allows him to pull heroes towards his friends.
Can send out a circular gravitational push that damages and knocks back all nearby heroes.
enemies.behavior: It pulls a distant retained hero toward its formation and switches at five units or nearer to the seven-unit damaging push, displacing every admitted nearby hero away from itself.

enemies.name: Lightning Stalker
descriptions: Slow-moving long-range orb shooter whose hits can briefly shock.
enemies.behavior: Its ranked projectile carries the authored shock chance and timed stun modifier.

enemies.name: Dimensionist
descriptions: Creates a lasting sphere that slows heroes and projectiles, then calls debris down while protected.
enemies.behavior: Slow Shield uses a removable 16-second globe, Meteor flows into the authored 12-unit target-facing strafe, distant targets are pursued, and the intermediate range admits either packaged laugh/taunt animation.

enemies.name: Decelerator
descriptions: Can instantly inflict a crippling debuff on nearby heroes, slowing their movement and attack speed.
Chases after slowed heroes and uses a physical melee attack.
enemies.behavior: Its six-second slow now enters the modifier inventory, reaches the client with the exact movement and attack operands, and contributes its movement operand to authoritative hero motion before the melee pursuit.

enemies.name: Undermind
descriptions: Ignites heroes, increases their Energy vulnerability, and gives allies a fiery buff.
enemies.behavior: Its fiery strike applies burning and stacking Energy vulnerability and projects the allied Energy-damage buff.

enemies.name: Shielded Grenadier
descriptions: Frontal shield blocks damage; lobs cluster grenades and knocks back close frontal heroes.
enemies.behavior: Directional shield admission, cluster submunitions, and the close bash all use their recovered phases.

enemies.name: Shade Drifter
descriptions: Difficult to hit physically; charges through and silences heroes; drains nearby life.
enemies.behavior: Noun Dodge Rating governs avoidance, the clipped through-target charge damages and silences every path contact, and each charge cycle pulses a local life-drain aura that heals the Drifter.
